channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Gen Z birdwatchers turn a traditional hobby into a modern trend
item.description: eBird director Christopher Wood told Fortune that bird watching has shifted from a niche activity to a popular one, especially among younger generations.

item.title: Nobel-winning historian links birthrates to men's reliability, but economics complicate it
item.description: The theory suggests that when men are seen as dependable partners rather than disappointments, investment in women's education and care increases, yet economic factors play a significant role.

item.title: Preply CEO Kirill Bigai credits his online tutor search for the platform's start
item.description: Kirill Bigai, cofounder and CEO of the $1.2 billion learning platform, initially took a consulting job while earning little to build the business.

item.title: Billionaires buy farmland for hobbies, but their purchases may push out working farmers
item.description: While some tech moguls enjoy farming as a pastime, the trend could disadvantage those who depend on agriculture for a living.
